name: MonarchAiChainOfSteps
title: AiChainOfSteps
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of step rows with androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator for the running step, folded into MonarchCollapsible
summary: The steps an assistant is working through, as an ordered list that updates live and folds under a summary such as "4 steps" when every step has finished.
whenToUse: In an AI answer, to show the plan or the chain of actions the assistant is running, with the state of each step.
whenNotToUse: For the hidden reasoning of a model use a reasoning part in MonarchAiConversation. For a multi-step form the person fills in use MonarchStepper.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiChainOfSteps(steps: List<MonarchAiPlanStep>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, details: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), collapsible: Boolean = true, initiallyExpanded: Boolean = false, announces: Boolean = true, stateIcon: (@Composable (MonarchAiPlanStepState) -> Unit)? = null, expandIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiChainOfStepsLabels = MonarchAiChainOfStepsLabels())

class MonarchAiChainOfStepsLabels(label: String? = null, state: ((MonarchAiPlanStepState) -> String)? = null, summary: ((count: Int, failed: Int) -> String)? = null, started: ((label: String, position: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, failedStep: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, finished: ((count: Int, failed: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: steps
options.description: The steps in order, for example from MonarchAiPlanPart. Update each state (Todo, Active, Done, Skipped, Failed) as the assistant works.

options.name: details
options.description: An optional detail under a step, such as a result or an error, by step id. Already localised.

options.name: collapsible
options.description: Whether the list folds under a summary once every step has finished.

options.name: initiallyExpanded
options.description: Whether the folded list starts open.

options.name: announces
options.description: Whether starts, failures and completion are announced to TalkBack. Turn it off when the thread announces progress itself.

options.name: stateIcon
options.description: An icon for every state but the running one, tinted by the state. Without it a drawn mark is shown: open for not started and skipped, filled for done and failed.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: The chevron of the folded summary, passed to MonarchCollapsible.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the list name, the state names, the summary and the announcements.

states.name: todo
states.description: An open mark in the subtle text color; muted label.

states.name: active
states.description: A small CircularProgressIndicator in the AI strong color, or a still filled mark when animations are removed.

states.name: done
states.description: A filled mark in the success strong color.

states.name: failed
states.description: A filled mark in the danger strong color and the word "Failed" under the label.

states.name: skipped
states.description: An open mark, a struck-through muted label and the word "Skipped".

states.name: folded
states.description: Once every step has finished, a MonarchCollapsible with the summary ("3 steps, 1 failed").

appearance: Marks take the AI strong, success strong, danger strong or subtle text roles by state; labels the default or muted text role; details the muted text role. The summary uses MonarchCollapsible. All colors are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The step model is the shared MonarchAiPlanStep, whose not-started state is Todo (pending on the web). As on iOS, details are a map by step id because the shared step model has no detail field. The web draws a shimmer on the running label and iOS shows SF Symbols per state; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the marks are drawn shapes that differ by fill as well as color, failed and skipped are also written, and stateIcon lets the app pass its own icons. The web announces through a live region; Android uses a polite live region on an always-present node. The folded state is kept inside the component with rememberSaveable, as on iOS.
accessibility: The list is a traversal group named "Steps".
Each step is one TalkBack element: the label, with the state name and the detail as its state description, so the state does not depend on the mark or color.
Failed and skipped steps also show their state in words.
A step that starts or fails, and the end of the run, are announced once through a polite live region; the state at first appearance is not.
The folded summary is the MonarchCollapsible header: a button with an Expanded or Collapsed state and a 48dp touch target.
When animations are removed the running step shows a still mark instead of a spinner.
edgeCases: Long labels and details wrap at every font size.
An empty list shows nothing and never folds.
Several changes in one update are announced together, joined by full stops.
Step ids should be unique; the last state of a repeated id is used for comparisons.

examples.title: Running
examples.template:
MonarchAiChainOfSteps(
    steps = listOf(
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.0.id}}, {{steps.0.label}}, MonarchAiPlanStepState.{{steps.0.state|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.1.id}}, {{steps.1.label}}, MonarchAiPlanStepState.{{steps.1.state|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.2.id}}, {{steps.2.label}}, MonarchAiPlanStepState.{{steps.2.state|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.3.id}}, {{steps.3.label}}, MonarchAiPlanStepState.{{steps.3.state|pascal}}),
    ),
    details = mapOf({{steps.1.id}} to {{steps.1.detail}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiChainOfSteps(
    steps = listOf(
        MonarchAiPlanStep("0", "Read the attached file", MonarchAiPlanStepState.Done),
        MonarchAiPlanStep("1", "Search earlier notes", MonarchAiPlanStepState.Done),
        MonarchAiPlanStep("2", "Compare the figures", MonarchAiPlanStepState.Active),
        MonarchAiPlanStep("3", "Draft a summary", MonarchAiPlanStepState.Todo),
    ),
    details = mapOf("1" to "3 notes matched"),
)

examples.title: From a plan part, with a failure detail
examples.code:
MonarchAiChainOfSteps(
    steps = plan.steps,
    details = mapOf("find" to "The date is not in the file."),
    initiallyExpanded = true,
)
